title: Token to Goal: 3 by 3 Grid Puzzle
description: A flat 3 by 3 board of grey tiles seen from above and in front. A blue sphere token starts on the bottom-left (near-left) square; an orange raised disc marks the goal on the top-right (far-right) square. Up, Down, Left and Right buttons move the token one square. Hint shows a green arrow from the token pointing along a move that brings it one step closer to the goal. Readouts give moves made and steps to goal.

game.objective: Move the token from the bottom-left square to the orange goal on the top-right square. The shortest route takes 4 moves.
game.hint: Steps to goal = rows between plus columns between. Every move toward the goal lowers it by one; press Hint to see such a move.

assumptions: This is a simple made-up puzzle, not a model of anything real.
The token moves only up, down, left or right, never diagonally, so 'steps to goal' counts the up/down steps plus the left/right steps (taxicab distance).
The token starts on the bottom-left square and the goal is the top-right square, so the shortest route takes 4 moves.
Once the token reaches the goal, the game is won and the move buttons stop working until you press Reset.
Up moves away from the camera's starting view, Right moves to the right. Start and goal are always the same; there are no walls, so the hint simply points toward the goal.
